title: NO MORE DEAF EARS (175)
style: happy hardcore, UK hardcore revival, 175 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), supersaw stack detuned wide, hoover bass stabs, four-on-the-floor pounding kick, snare rolls, sidechain pumping everything to the kick, signal-clearing synth sweeps, euphoric uplift, festival mainstage 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro — 0:00 — pads, signal sweep, sub swell, faint kick pulse]
(chop, +6) "No — more — deaf — ears"
(chop, +6) "Signal — not — noise"
(chop, +6) "G4 — Lens — hears — it"
(chop, +6) "Mansion — wide — open"

[Build — 0:16 — hoover roll, riser, snare 4/8/16/32]
(chant, up) "Signal — signal — signal — signal"
(chant, down) "Not — noise — not — noise"
(chant, up) "Finich — not — finish"
(riser hold)

[Drop 1 — 0:32 — full hardcore, supersaws wide, kick fours]
(stacked) "NO — MORE — DEAF — EARS!"
(call) "SIGNAL — NOT — NOISE!"
(stacked) "G4 — LENS — HEARS — IT!"
(call) "MANSION — WIDE — OPEN!"
(stacked) "FINICH — NOT — FINISH!"

[Verse — 1:04 — half-time, piano + saw stabs]
(chop run) "Receiver — finally — tuned"
(chop run) "Channel — locked — in"
(chop run) "Keel — holds — the — line"
(chop run) "Three — three — six — clear"
(chop run) "No — more — deaf — ears — tonight"

[Breakdown — 1:36 — strip to piano + lone chop, no kick]
(chop, slow, +8) "Three..."
(chop) "Three..."
(chop) "Six..."
(chop, fading) "Signal — received"
(riser, white noise, snare roll)

[Drop 2 — 2:00 — double-time, full euphoria]
(wall) "NO — MORE — DEAF — EARS!"
(wall) "SIGNAL — NOT — NOISE!"
(wall) "G4 — LENS — ON!"
(wall) "MANSION — WIDE — OPEN!"
(wall) "FINICH — NOT — FINISH!"

[Outro — 2:32 — fade on chop + sub]
(chop, fading, +6) "No more deaf ears..."
(chop, fading) "Signal not noise..."
(chop, fading) "Mansion open..."
(sub pulse out)
